description: Use for a generic tournament request with no confirmed sport or format, or to discover NextArena's supported sports, formats, entrant types and limits. Does not generate a tournament or select defaults. With no sport, ask Pickleball or padel first; with a confirmed sport, return only its formats. Do not display all formats as interchangeable across sports.

sport.description: Only include a sport the user has selected for this tournament. Omit it when unknown; never infer it from unrelated previous requests.
